mechanism: TimeSeriesSplit compare MSE of Normal (OHLC+MA), Alternative (IUDSOIA+SOFR), and All predictors; boxplots show All has squashed error distribution (lower variance) vs long-tailed single-source models. Linear model preferred when MSE band similar but variance lowest.

mechanism: Multilayered Iterative Algorithm builds a polynomial neural net: take inputs two-at-a-time, fit partial polynomials (linear / linear_cov / quadratic), rank by external criterion on hold-out (reg, stab, unbiasedOut, absoluteNoiseImmun, …), keep kBest nodes, transform their outputs into next-layer inputs until criterion stops improving. Final retained coeffs define nested VKG-style polynomial.
data_needed: Train/test split; matrix of predictors or timeSeriesTransformation(lags); CriterionType; kBest; pAverage; limit; PolynomialType.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Toy series and multivariable demos; USDCHF chart context; general any symbol/TF via vectors
why_new_for_mis: Inductive multilayer polynomial net with explicit external noise/stability criteria is a sequence sensor architecture MIS can train online without hand-picked AR terms.
quote: GMDH algorithms employ a data-driven approach to modeling, where models are generated and refined based on observed data rather than preconceived notions or theoretical assumptions.

mechanism: timeSeriesTransformation(vector, lags) slides lag windows into X rows and next value into y; MIA.fit then predicts multi-step by recursive predict(x, lags). Lags≥3 required for MIA.
